title: Claiborne Pell, Jack Reed and Biden: a UFO lineage
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Claiborne Pell, Jack Reed and Biden: a UFO lineage, about unspecified at US Senate, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Claybourne Pel was this senator who was long into UFOs who's from Delaware.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Claiborne Pell was a US senator with a long interest in UFOs, and he places him in a line of politicians that also includes Senator Jack Reed and Joe Biden. Michels tells it to suggest that interest in UFOs has been passed along quietly among people at the top of the US Senate.
